title: Punjab and Haryana High Court halts fresh allotment of flats in Oberoi Realty's ultra-luxury project in Gurugram
description: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has restrained further allotment of flats to homebuyers in Oberoi Realty’s ‘Three Sixty North’ residential project in Gurugram till Director Town and Country Planning (DTCP) takes a decision on a complaint seeking cancellation of its license.A Division Bench of Justice Jasgurpreet Singh Puri and Justice Sanjiv Berry directed the DTCP to decide the complaint moved by Advance India Projects Limited either on July 20 or within two weeks after giving adequate opport
